mathematical_meanings: Left image: The graph segment indicates that the temperature remains 100 °C during that time interval. Right image: The graph segment plots constant S = 4 between those times.
Rationales: In both images the feature plots a constant function output over an interval. The solid flat part of the temperature trace at 100 °C. The flat graph segment from t = 2 to t = 4 at S = 4.
